result.summary: The image shows a signalized intersection adjacent to a hospital with high-visibility crosswalks and wide sidewalks. However, the presence of an elevated structure creates significant shadows over the roadway, and dedicated pedestrian signals are not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Shadowing from elevated structure
hazards.description: The large overhead structure creates deep shadows that can obscure pedestrians from drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image over the roadway

hazards.name: Missing pedestrian signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signals are visible at this signalized intersection near a hospital.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signals with countdown timers to provide clear information to people crossing.

interventions.title: Under-deck Lighting
interventions.description: Improve lighting under the elevated structure to increase visibility and safety.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to reduce crossing distance and slow turning vehicles.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by an intersection located beneath an elevated rail structure, which introduces significant visual obstructions via large steel support pillars. While basic infrastructure like sidewalks, curb ramps, and marked crosswalks are present, the heavy shadows and physical clutter from the pillars and construction barrels create a complex and potentially hazardous crossing.

hazards.name: Elevated Rail Pillars
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the overhead rail are positioned near the intersection corners, significantly obstructing sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and left foreground, supporting the blue overhead structure

hazards.name: Low Visibility and Shadows
hazards.description: The overhead structure creates deep shadows that can obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming motorists.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area directly beneath the elevated tracks

hazards.name: Parked Vehicle Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection on the side street further limit visibility for pedestrians entering the crosswalk.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk at the corners to move pedestrians past the pillars and parked cars into the driver's line of sight before they begin crossing.

interventions.title: Enhanced Under-Structure Lighting
interventions.description: Install high-intensity, pedestrian-scale LED lighting under the elevated rail to eliminate dark spots and improve visibility at all hours.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalks to ensure clear sightlines for all road users.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is dominated by an elevated transit structure whose support pillars create significant visual obstructions at the intersection. While marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals are present, the physical layout forces pedestrians to step out from behind large steel columns into the path of potential traffic.

hazards.name: Structural Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: Large steel support pillars for the elevated track are located immediately adjacent to the crosswalk, severely blocking sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right foreground, supporting the overhead structure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to move pedestrians past the visual obstruction of the pillars before they enter the travel lane.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval (LPI)
interventions.description: Program the traffic signal to give pedestrians a 3-7 second head start before the parallel vehicle traffic gets a green light.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks and a marked crosswalk, but lacks modern safety enhancements. The environment is characterized by poor pavement quality and sightline obstructions caused by vehicles parked close to the corner.

hazards.name: Pavement degradation
hazards.description: A significant pothole or area of broken pavement is visible in the roadway near the pedestrian crossing area.

hazards.name: Sightline obstruction
hazards.description: Parked vehicles along the side street are positioned very close to the intersection, potentially blocking the view between drivers and pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the image along the curb

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces closest to the intersection to improve visibility for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the crossing distance and prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

interventions.title: Pavement Repair
interventions.description: Resurface the intersection to eliminate tripping hazards and prevent vehicles from swerving to avoid potholes.
